experiment: MCQ nearest-option snapping, tested retroactively against all 30 raw computed answers + real distractor options, zero additional agent compute
conclusion: Nearest-option snapping only recovers points when the analysis is approximately-right-but-differently-formatted. None of this baseline's current failures fit that pattern -- all are genuinely-wrong values from a different methodology, which snapping cannot fix. Important correction to an earlier-session hypothesis that assumed near-miss values would be common.
